preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 30000 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n is between 1 and 30,000 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 4 for c in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: The maximum cost of the operation c is between 1 and 4 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= q <= 300000 for q in [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 300,000 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for n, line in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]], stdin.splitlines()[2::3]))
preconditions.description: The number of elements in the permutation matches the specified length n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for n, line in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]], stdin.splitlines()[2::3]))
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(queries) == q for q, queries in zip([int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+3:i+3+q] for i, q in enumerate([int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])]))
preconditions.description: The number of queries matches the specified q for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= 10**18 for x, y in [line.split() for line in queries]) for n, queries in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+3:i+3+q] for i, q in enumerate([int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])]))
preconditions.description: Each query i and j is between 1 and n, and 1 and 10^18 respectively for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in return_value)
all(answer == -1 or 1 <= answer <= n for answer, n in zip(return_value, [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]]))
postconditions.description: Each answer is either -1 or a valid position in the permutation.
